exceptions.rationale: ESLint 9/minimatch 3 requires the brace-expansion 1.x CommonJS API. Forcing brace-expansion 5.x breaks that API, while ESLint 10 remains blocked by eslint-plugin-react/eslint-plugin-jsx-a11y peer ranges in the current Next.js lint stack. Only this dev-only advisory chain is tolerated, and only when every installed brace-expansion copy is on the line-compatible patched floor checked by scripts/audit-security.mjs.
